name: Blast Battles💥
desc:
💥 Welcome to Blast Battles! 💥
Blast your friends into oblivion with a wide range of unique Tnt's 

How to play:
🕹️ - Select a TNT in spawn and Jump down to battle
💨 - You can Push your TNT by Right Clicking on it
🏃 -  Shift to sprint 

👍 Thumbs up and favorite for more updates!

UPDATE 1:
🧨 - 8 new Tnt's
🏅 - 6 Badges
❓ - Codes
🔋 - Fridge has health
🚀 - Streaks
📱 - Mobile users can push Tnt's and Sprint
🐛 - Alot of bugs fixed

🔨The game is in testing so send me a message if you have suggestions or feedback you want to share <3 :]
The game was released 5.16.22
